text:
B: Hello. Can you hear me okay?
A: Erm, yes. Hello. Sorry, I was just checking my sound.
B: No problem. I'm Gareth.
A: Joanne.
B: Where are you?
A: Crawley.
B: Andover, me.
A: Right.
B: Er, did you do alright with the puzzle?
A: I think so. I quite liked it.
B: Same. Took me a while, though.
A: Yeah.
B: What do you do, work-wise?
A: Erm, I'm between jobs. I was purchase ledger for seventeen years at a builders' merchants. Made redundant when they got bought out.
B: Seventeen years. That's a long time to give somewhere.
A: It was, yeah. The man I spoke to before runs one, actually. A builders' merchants.
B: Darren? Basingstoke? I had him first.
A: Yes. He's, erm, quite chatty.
B: He is, yeah. Nice enough bloke. I'm in warehousing, operations. We've got three sites. Honestly, people like you are the ones I'd keep if I had the choice. Everyone thinks it's the forklift drivers who keep the place running, and they do, but if purchase ledger's a mess you find out three months later when a haulier's charging you twice for the same load and nobody's noticed. Good accounts people catch that.
A: Erm, that used to happen. Duplicate invoices. I'd always check against the delivery notes.
B: That's exactly it. Are you looking for the same sort of thing?
A: Part-time, ideally. Somewhere local. Not on reception or phones.
B: Makes sense. Agencies always want to stick people on reception.
A: They do. I've turned a couple down.
B: Fair enough.
A: Erm.
B: I saw you've got a dog. In the photo.
A: Oh. Bobby. Jack Russell. He's fourteen.
B: We had a spaniel. She died a couple of years back. Haven't had the heart for another yet.
A: Oh, I'm sorry. Bobby's back leg's going, so I do sort of think about it.
B: Yeah. You don't think about it till it happens. Do you walk him much?
A: Every morning. Tilgate Park. Same way round each time.
B: I'm the same with running. Same route every day, about five k. My wife says I'd get lost if they moved a tree.
A: My mum says that about me.
B: Do you get away at all? Holidays?
A: Isle of Wight. Caravan, every September, with my mum and dad.
B: We do the Algarve. Same place, eight years running. I can't be doing with looking for somewhere new.
A: No. I don't like flying, so.
B: Airports are a hassle anyway. The A303's bad enough in August.
A: Is it the—
